name: qima-pm-skills
description: QIMA PM Skills — long interview, short output. Bundles `write-prd` (end-to-end PRD orchestrator), `codebase-understanding` (architecture / repo / team brief), and the `prd-review-expert` agent. The PRD flow asks 6–15 background questions + up to 7 depth rounds + 5 clarification rounds before drafting, writes a ≤ 250-line PM-readable Confluence PRD with per-page Figma deep-links in §6 Design (frame search SCOPED to user-provided section node-id; rendered via Figma for Confluence plugin as live embeds), and auto-reviews via prd-review-expert.
